text: Tameeni, Saudi Arabia's online insurance aggregator, is a flagship subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology Co., which listed 22.74 million shares (30% of its capital) on the Main Market of the Saudi Exchange in June 2024. MENAbytes names Saudi venture-capital firm Impact46 as Rasan's largest shareholder.
short: Tameeni is a flagship subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology, listed on the Saudi Exchange; Impact46 named largest shareholder.

source.name: Rasan Information Technology – Investor Relations: Our IPO
source.quote: providing seamless services through our flagship subsidiaries, including Tameeni
